نستعلي (form X)
# نَسْتَعْلِي (nastaʕlī) /nas.taʕ.liː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَعْلَى (istaʕlā)
# نَسْتَعْلِيَ (nastaʕliya) /nas.taʕ.li.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَعْلَى (istaʕlā)
